questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will logically complete the

series.

ME_ICM_DIC_GDI_MHD_C
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: ME_ICM_DIC_GDI_MHD_C

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) DEMAI → ME__D__IC / M__E__DIC / __M__GDI__A__ / MHD__I__C

Option 2) DCFMI → ME__D__IC / M__C__DIC / __F__GDI__M__ / MHD__I__C

Option 3) DFMBI → ME__D__IC / M__F__DIC / __M__GDI__B__ / MHD__I__C

Option 4) **DFMCI**** **→ ME__**D**__IC / M__**F**__DIC / __**M**__GDI__**C**__ / MHD__**I**__C

Here, 2nd letter is increased by 1 and 1st, 3rd, 4th and 5th letters are the same.

**2nd letter: **E + 1 = F; F + 1 = G; G + 1 = H;

Hence, the correct answer is **"DFMCI".**

questions.question: 21 is related to 220 by certain logic. Following the same logic, 72 is related to 781. To which of the following is 27 related, following the same logic? (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number × 10) + (1st number - 11) = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 21 : 220

⇒ (21 × 10) + (21 - 11) = 210 + 10 = 220.

For, 72 : 781

⇒ (72 × 10) + (72 - 11) = 720 + 61 = 781.

Similarly, for 27 ∶ ?

**⇒ (27 × 10) + (27 - 11) = 270 + 16 = 286.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

_ Y R W I Y _ X I _ R _ I Y R Z
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: _ Y R W I Y _ X I _ R _ I Y R Z

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) XRYX → __X__ Y R W / I Y __R__ X / I __Y__ R __X__ / I Y R Z

Option 2) IRZY → __I__ Y R W / I Y __R__ X / I __Z__ R __Y__ / I Y R Z

**Option 3) IRYY → __I__** Y R W / I Y __**R**__ X / I __**Y**__ R __**Y**__ / I Y R Z

Here, 4th letter is increased by 1, and 1st three letters are the same.

W + 1 = X; X + 1 = Y; Y + 1 = Z

Option 4) IYYX → __I__ Y R W / I Y __Y__ X / I __Y__ R __X__ / I Y R Z

Hence, the correct answer is **"IRYY".**

questions.question:
Six letters O, Z, F, T, R and M are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figures below. Find the letter on the face opposite to Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb6e06839254f1e96388687b2a8eadcbcc3825e4ca9c31df9f8d748a998d7244.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a636623c94f436280d25c53c24cae9da7cb1605964604bf8a6f72a3d9cc544f.png]
questions.solution:
For find the opposite surface of 'Z', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05c1227492585cb676107c2b273feb3cc05b92aa82faf70b7a3563a8a7d6e0a3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/222351a15f1dc67f76ff80348203e55bbf1eaf46246dc6d4009ae2c6ce38a717.png] 

From both dices, Z is common and on the same surface. So, all remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

Z→ M

O→ T

F → R

O is opposite to T.

F is opposite to R.

So, M will be opposite to Z.

Hence, the correct answer is "M".
